1800 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Subtract 83 days from 1800-10-17:  
October 17 → back 17 days → September 30.  
Remaining 83 - 17 = 66 days.  
September has 30 days → back 30 days → August 31.  
Remaining 66 - 30 = 36 days.  
August 31 → back 31 days → July 31.  
Remaining 36 - 31 = 5 days.  
July 31 → back 5 days → July 26.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1800-07-26
